user.title: UGREEN Connect
user.description: Sign in with the same account you use in the UgreenConnect app. Pick the region your account was registered in — accounts are not shared between regions. Everything else has a sensible default and can be changed afterwards.

data.debug_dump: Write a raw cloud snapshot to the config folder

data_description.debug_dump: Saves ugreen_connect_plus_debug.json once per restart. Useful while the integration is still being built out; safe to turn off later.
data_description.port_devices: Every port becomes a device of its own, so a port answers for itself. Turned off, everything hangs on the charger instead. It can be changed later, but changing it moves entities between devices, and whatever pointed at the old ones has to be set up again -- so it is worth deciding now.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate UGREEN Connect
reauth_confirm.description: The password for {email} was rejected. Enter it again.

reconfigure.title: UGREEN Connect Plus
reconfigure.description: Change the account or the region this charger is reached through. It has to stay the same account -- a different one is a different set of chargers, and these entities belong to this one.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the UGREEN cloud.
error.invalid_auth: The account or password was rejected.
error.wrong_account: That is a different account from the one this was set up with. Add it as its own integration rather than changing this one over.

abort.already_configured: This account is already set up.

set_wallpaper.name: Set wallpaper
set_wallpaper.description: Upload a picture and show it on the charger's screen. It is cropped to 560x170 from the centre; the card lets you choose the crop yourself.

device_id.name: Charger
device_id.description: Which charger to send the picture to.

path.name: File
path.description: Path to an image on the Home Assistant host, e.g. /config/www/desk.jpg.

url.name: URL
url.description: Address of an image to fetch and upload.

image.name: Image data
image.description: The picture itself, base64 encoded, with or without a data: prefix.

data.debug_dump: Write a raw cloud snapshot to the config folder

data_description.scan_interval: How often a reading arrives. Measured start to start, so the wait for the charger to answer comes out of this rather than being added to it. 5 s keeps the wattage live; raise it to lean less on UGREEN's servers.
data_description.region: Only change this if the account itself was moved to another server. The password is checked against the new region before the change is kept.
data_description.debug_dump: Saves ugreen_connect_plus_debug.json on every refresh. It is the unedited cloud payload.
data_description.nominal_voltage: Used only to read a session's watt-hours back as milliamp-hours. 3.85 V is the nominal cell voltage of phones, earbuds and handhelds; a laptop's pack is far higher, and its milliamp-hour figure means nothing until this matches it.
data_description.efficiency: How much of what leaves the port reaches the cell. The rest becomes heat in the cable and the device's own converter.
data_description.session_idle_end: How long a port must deliver nothing before its charging session is called finished and the next one may start. The charger keeps a port live for as long as something has announced itself on it -- a charging puck does that with nothing lying on it, though a cable on its own does not -- so this is the only thing that can end a session. Long enough that a phone topping itself up at 100% stays one session; shorter if you swap devices on the same cable within a couple of hours.
data_description.port_devices: Every port appears as a device of its own, so a port's page answers for that port and nothing else. Turned off, everything hangs on the charger: one device instead of nine, and fifty entities on one page. Changing this moves entities between devices -- their history is kept, but anything pointing at a device rather than an entity, such as an area, a device card or a device trigger, has to be set again.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the UGREEN cloud.
error.invalid_auth: The account or password was rejected in that region.

mode_not_selectable.message: {mode} cannot be set from Home Assistant. It needs the parameters that only the UgreenConnect app's own mode editor fills in, and sending invented ones would overwrite what is configured there.

readings_stale.title: The charger's readings have stopped arriving
readings_stale.description: Nothing whole has come back from UGREEN's cloud for {minutes} minutes, so every value shown for this charger is at least that old. Short outages are ordinary here and pass on their own; this long usually means the account was signed in elsewhere, or the charger is off the network.
